## What's Changed
* build(deps): bump the github-actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/7
* build(deps): bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.3.1 to 10.3.3 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/8
* Add Kemory MCP server badge to README by @karol-blaszczyk in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/9
* docs: document package layering in CONTRIBUTING by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/10
* docs(readme): describe what kemory upgrade does by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/11
* test(auth): cover the 300s expiry default when expires_in is missing by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/15
* test(config): cover each required credentials field by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/14
* test(exits): pin the status-to-exit-code mapping by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/18
* test(config): cover credentials file without env defaulting to DefaultEnv by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/16
* fix(auth): report issuer 5xx on token refresh as a network error by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/17
* test(stats): pin the stats memories views by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/19
* test: run table-style test cases as named subtests by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/20
* test(render): cover styled tables, checks and messages at a fixed width by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/23
* fix(doctor): name apps in restart notes and share the entry-writing step with connect by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/21
* fix(auth): use the saved session when a concurrent refresh wins by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/22
* fix(export): keep the existing file when kemory export -o fails by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/12
* test(keys): pin rotate, approve, revoke and delete output and exit codes by @s9n-agent[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/13

## New Contributors
* @s9n-agent[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/10

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/compare/v0.19.0...v0.19.1

## What's Changed
* feat(release): list kemory in the official MCP Registry (S9N-11710) by @karol-blaszczyk in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/6
* build(deps): bump the github-actions group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/5
* build(deps): bump github.com/charmbracelet/bubbles from 0.21.1-0.20250623103423-23b8fd6302d7 to 1.0.0 in the go-modules group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/pull/4


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/SeKondBrainAILabs/kemory-cli/compare/v0.18.19...v0.19.0
